comment: Curated corrections to the community sender-ID directory (india_sender_ids.json.gz). Entries here are consulted BEFORE the bundled sender_ids.db, so a bad upstream entry can be fixed without regenerating the large SQLite asset. Keys are sender IDs after TRAI normalization (VD-INDPST -> INDPST). Keep this file in sync with app/src/main/assets/sender_id_corrections.json (a unit test enforces it).
